projects.name: DSRclone
projects.status_line: Private repo · VAPT platform build in progress

commits.subject: fix(launch-safety): wave 1 — proxy-keyed rate limits, guarded verification fetch, consent record, self-service account rights, focus visibility

feat(legal): replace the §166 draft-placeholder legal pages with the operator's real documents for this deployment — Terms (authorized-use-only as a condition, AI-features honesty, liability), Privacy (what is collected and why, AI processing with redaction disclosed, no sale/no trackers/no session replay), Acceptable Use, Security (real controls, vulnerability reporting, no certification claims), Subprocessors (Render/Neon/Supabase/UptimeRobot/AI route as actually used) — and surface them where users decide: legal links in the sign-in card footer and a Terms/Privacy consent line on the sign-up form. Dependency license scan: no copyleft (GPL/AGPL/LGPL) in production deps; data endpoints re-verified 401 for anonymous callers

fix(security): close the five 'vibe-coded app' risks for DSRclone — (1) /metrics was publicly readable on the hosted deployment (request counts, memory, uptime): now Bearer-token gated via METRICS_TOKEN and 404-invisible when unset; (2) the AI service's /copilot/generate spent live provider quota with NO auth and NO cap: now requires the AI_SERVICE_KEY shared secret (401), a hard per-IP rate cap of 30/min keyed on the last XFF hop (429), and pydantic field caps so context size cannot mean unbounded spend; (3) registration had no attempt bucket despite bcrypt+3 table writes per call: per-IP cap 10/hour via the existing §22 bucket machinery; (4) accessibility: sidebar group toggles expose aria-expanded and the mobile drawer closes on Escape (labels/dialog semantics were already in place); storage bucket + DB verified NOT publicly accessible (unauthenticated probes 404) and the remaining @Public endpoints are signature/API-key/correlation-token authenticated by design

fix(admin): admin plane must not vanish until re-login — (1) platform RBAC now honors the isPlatformAdmin deployment flag (§96): the role map alone closed the plane whenever the current org context carried a lesser role, while the console still offered it; (2) /admin retries a failed dashboard load with backoff + a Retry button (one cold-start failure used to stick until remount); (3) Shell retries /auth/me so the Admin Panel link survives an API wake-up; (4) apiFetch treats a 401 with an existing token as an expired session: clears it and returns to /login instead of leaving every gated page silently broken
Docs: README — console bullet (Admin Panel with all-services live status, profile page, one-front-door wake-up) + verified-live line now covers the full seven-service status

feat(platform): one front door — opening the web console wakes the AI + worker services (fire-and-forget pings from the Shell; CSP connect-src extended to the peer origins, env-derived like the API origin), and the Admin Panel system status now lists the WHOLE deployment: HealthService.serviceChecks() HTTP-probes the AI copilot, worker and web console (an HTTP answer proves the service is awake; a timeout honestly reads 'no response — may be waking up'), merged into /platform/dashboard over the infra checks; WORKER_SERVICE_URL/WEB_APP_URL config + render.yaml wiring (reference-deployment defaults, overridable)
